generated_from: verified upstream source artifacts with deterministic normalization

denominators.note: retrieval_supported = all categories with evidence spans (75). answer_supported = ordinary support categories excluding qualified (70). qualified = conditional_or_qualified scored separately (5). rejection = unsupported + false_premise + misleading_overlap (45).

metric_formulas.Recall@K: |relevant expected documents in top K| / |relevant expected documents|, macro-averaged
metric_formulas.HitRate@K: 1 if at least one relevant document in top K, else 0, macro-averaged
metric_formulas.MRR: 1 / rank of first relevant document (0 if none), macro-averaged

independence_statement: No holdout_v1 PEP sources, holdout_v2 authored notes, Stage 5 RFC documents, evaluation_suite_v3 inline cases, or production knowledge corpus data are reused. All 120 cases derived exclusively from verified upstream source artifacts committed under evaluation/holdout_v3/sources/.

contamination_review.note: 26 same-domain overlaps are expected (V3 and V1/V2 cover overlapping technical domains). These are semantically different questions with Jaccard < 0.5. 4121 shared generic stems (e.g., 'what is the') are question-pattern overlap, not contamination.
